cards.direction_or_boundary: A three-term model using u·u_x, u_xx, and sin(x)sin(t) is selected from the richer library and explains virtually all derivative variance on held-out contiguous time blocks.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Central finite differences, sequential thresholded least squares over a frozen 13-term library, train-on-two/validate-on-one contiguous time blocks, threshold perturbation, admitted Gaussian smoothing up to sigma 0.5, and spatial-boundary exclusion; sigma 1 is frozen as a non-admitted stress boundary because it adds terms.
cards.object: The complete dense synthetic spatiotemporal field and its full coordinate grids.
cards.one_liner: Thresholded selection from a 13-term competing library recovers a three-term forced nonlinear diffusion equation with coefficients near −1, 0.1, and 1.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A new initial-condition field supports the relationship only if the same three terms are selected with their signs and held-out derivative R² above 0.98; any term loss/addition, sign reversal, or R² at or below 0.98 is failure.

cards.scope: This synthetic field only; numerical differentiation and candidate-library choices define the reconstruction boundary.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The author implementation defines the active coefficients as −1 for u·u_x, 0.1 for u_xx, and 1 for sin(x)sin(t).
target_alignment.paper_location: Author code for the forced Burgers example and Results on sparse governing-equation recovery.

cards.direction_or_boundary: Integrated field magnitude increases more than threefold in every channel while spatial-time fields remain correlated.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Spatial trapezoidal integration with sum, channel holdout, and domain-trimming alternatives.
cards.object: The complete sparse three-channel cell-density field over 0, 12, 24, 36, and 48 hours and the retained source assay positions.
cards.one_liner: All three experimental channels show monotone integrated growth over five times and share correlated spatial dynamics.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: An additional replicate supports the relationship if integrated density is strictly monotone and its 48 h/0 h ratio exceeds three; nonmonotonicity or a ratio at or below three is failure.

cards.scope: Descriptive shared growth across three replicate channels; this anchor does not force the synthetic equation onto experimental data.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source models sparse replicate cell-density fields with migration and proliferation dynamics over 0–48 h.
target_alignment.paper_location: Experimental cell migration/proliferation Results and author-released scratch-assay field.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
